mobbin:4359c189-557b-424c-af85-3b1a7b574.summary: From empty Products the user starts 'Add new product', fills name, barcode, brand, measure, descriptions, photo, category, Pricing and Inventory (stock code / SKU), saves, and lands on Product list.
steal: Before any products exist, one pitch offers 'Start now', import many at once, and low stock reminders together (screen 1).
Barcode validation warns without blocking save (screens 3–9).
A measure list paired with Amount (ml 100) fits volume consumables (screens 4–5).
An 'Enable retail sales' switch can hide sell and commission fields when the item is stock-only (screen 10).
avoid: Team member commission plus markup and tax on create are salon POS fields, not sim equipment (screens 10–11).
mobbin:4359c189-557b-424c-af85-3b1a7b574.fit: Inventory: extends basic items with barcode plus unit and amount for consumables and later scan check-out; clash if we ship full retail pricing on create. Splitting Catalog from Inventory (Stocktakes / Stock orders / Suppliers) is a useful structure hint.
